description: Calculates by Israeli rules (dates of the checked rules are returned): mode="net" — monthly take-home pay from gross (income tax, Bituah Leumi, pension); mode="overtime" — pay for one week with overtime, night shifts and Shabbat/holiday work (125/150/175/200%). Use when a worker asks what they should be paid. An estimate, not legal advice.

rest.description: Shabbat, holiday or the weekly rest day.

extra_credit_points.description: mode=net: extra tax credit points (children, new immigrant, residence), only if the user knows them.

gender.description: mode=net: affects basic tax credit points.

locale.description: Language of names and links (default ru).
